items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Howard was ahead of me at school. ... Howard was a very serious musician. ... he thought he would get a saxophone too. ... Howard was playing saxophone

ctx.x: Was Howard in any of your classes, too?
No. Howard was ahead of me at school. There was two years difference in our ages. Naturally, age will make you... A two years difference, you know.
And Hodges was ahead of you, too.
